create PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACTION_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction AS(
SELECT
	BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS CustomerActionTypeId
	,BCA.KYC_DATE AS CustomerActionTimestamp
	,NULL AS CustomerActionValue
	,NULL AS CustomerActionNote
	,BCA.KYC_STATUS AS CustomerActionStatusId
	,NULL AS SourcePartyId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCA.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCAD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CRM_AMLKYC_DELTA BCAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_AMLKYC  BCA
ON 	BCAD.AML_KYC_ID = BCA.AML_KYC_ID AND BCAD.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID AND BCA.isLatest = '1'
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(KYC_DATE) KYCDTE FROM BUSC.CRM_AMLKYC WHERE isLatest = '1' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) KYCDTE ON KYCDTE.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND KYCDTE.KYCDTE = BCA.KYC_DATE --ADDED FOR DUP
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_AMLKYC WHERE isLatest = '1' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCA.TMDATE --ADDED FOR DUP
WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL AND KYCDTE.KYCDTE IS NOT NULL



)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_SRC AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, CustomerActionTimestamp, CustomerActionStatusId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, CustomerActionTimestamp, CustomerActionStatusId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAction
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
	,[CustomerActionTypeId] = NULL
	,[CustomerActionTimestamp] = SRC.CustomerActionTimestamp
	,[CustomerActionValue] = NULL
	,[CustomerActionNote] = NULL
	,[CustomerActionStatusId] = SRC.CustomerActionStatusId
	,[SourcePartyId] = NULL
	,[SourceCode] = 'CRM'
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = getDate()	
FROM BNKM.CustomerAction TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAction (
	[CustomerId]
	,[CustomerActionTypeId]
	,[CustomerActionTimestamp]
	,[CustomerActionValue]
	,[CustomerActionNote]
	,[CustomerActionStatusId]
	,[SourcePartyId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerId]
	,[CustomerActionTypeId]
	,[CustomerActionTimestamp]
	,[CustomerActionValue]
	,[CustomerActionNote]
	,[CustomerActionStatusId]
	,[SourcePartyId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACTION
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAction_DELTA;

END
